head: Channel Launcher puts UK live TV channels in one guide
dek: Channel Launcher is a live TV guide for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV that brings UK channels like BBC together and opens the right app to watch. It was #31 among all paid apps on the UK App Store on 7 November.
where: UK, iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, £5.99
means: If you hunt through a dozen apps to find what's on, this lists it all.
todo: Find Channel Launcher in the App Store.
thumb_words: ALL UK LIVE TV IN ONE GUIDE
